description: Symptom-to-cause triage for PayProbe failures. Load this when something is broken and you need to find out WHY: load runs stuck as "running" forever, crypto nodes returning {"error": ...} dicts, tests failing locally but green in CI, KeyError 'target', 401/503 on every API call, WebSocket closing immediately, TCP steps hanging or timing out, port collisions on topology start, 424 "required topology is not running", simulators vanishing after a restart, empty run history, chaos faults that won't stop, or a load run that got slower than last time. Contains the first-five-minutes checklist, a symptom→cause→experiment→fix table, and the trap stories that cost real time.
